scope: All 6 keys of ui.settings.privacy read in full against the en value and en .context.json (round-2 copy: full privacy stays on; no conversations, prompts, files or session details ever collected, stored or used; turn off at any time; no added IP/personal-data claims), glossary and locale style guide; mechanically checked key parity with en, no ICU placeholders, NFC, no Cc/Cf characters, no ASCII '...'. 'पूरी निजता चालू रहती है' = full privacy stays on; 'इकट्ठा, संग्रहित या इस्तेमाल' keeps all three verbs; 'सत्र का विवरण' per glossary (session → सत्र); प्रॉम्प्ट per glossary; 'आप इसे कभी भी बंद कर सकते हैं' = turn off.

findings.note: 'पूरी निजता' while the section title/description and save_failed in the same namespace use 'गोपनीयता' for privacy; both are correct Hindi and both already ship (ui.shell uses निजता), so meaning is intact. Optional: 'पूरी गोपनीयता चालू रहती है' for in-panel consistency.
